# DNS and TLS

Observed on 2026-08-15: `klyrow.com`, `www`, `app`, `api`, `track`, and `bounce` resolve to `37.27.128.39`. `mail.klyrow.com`, MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC and PTR were absent. Publish and verify:

| Type | Name | Value |
|---|---|---|
| A | `mail.klyrow.com` | `37.27.128.39` |
| MX | `klyrow.com` | `10 mail.klyrow.com.` |
| MX | `bounce.klyrow.com` | `10 mail.klyrow.com.` |
| TXT | `klyrow.com` | `v=spf1 ip4:37.27.128.39 -all` |
| TXT | `_dmarc.klyrow.com` | `v=DMARC1; p=quarantine; rua=mailto:dmarc@klyrow.com; adkim=s; aspf=s; pct=100` |
| TXT | `postal._domainkey.klyrow.com` | `v=DKIM1; t=s; h=sha256; ;` |
| CNAME | `track.klyrow.com` | use A record already present, not both CNAME and A |

The hosting provider must set PTR for `37.27.128.39` to `mail.klyrow.com`; forward-confirmed reverse DNS must then resolve back to the same IP. The DKIM value above was generated by deployed Postal from its persistent ignored `signing.key` on 2026-08-15; regenerate the documented value if that private key is rotated. Run `scripts/verify-dns` after publication.

After records propagate, obtain separate or SAN Let's Encrypt certificates for web names and `mail.klyrow.com`. Postal SMTP TLS must mount the resulting keypair. HELO/EHLO is `mail.klyrow.com`.
